tasks.short: Direct admissions, registration and career services departments.

steps.what: Read pipeline counts for admissions, registration and careers.
Direct the admissions, registration and career services departments.
Set the week's priorities in a short direction note.

loop.input: Direction notes and the pipeline table
loop.output: A note of priorities, each tied to a count or a spoken point
loop.check: Administrator removes any priority the meeting did not set
loop.stop: One draft. A queue with no spoken priority is listed as a count only.
loop.why_not_simpler: The meeting's choices are notes, not a form

steps.what: Send the direction note to the department leads.
Walk the registration desk when a deadline is close.

tasks.design: A {BI} view shows admissions, registration and careers queues before the meeting with the department leads. A bounded pass drafts the direction note only from that meeting and those counts. The note is sent after the administrator edits it. Walking the registration desk at a deadline stays in person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Counts were collected by asking each office, and the week's priorities were repeated in mail.
tasks.enabler_now: The three queues can be shown together when they share a period and a programme id.
tasks.still_hard: Directing the leads, and being on the desk when a deadline is failing.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator sets the week's priorities. The queue does not.

ambition.what: Which admissions or registration queue needs the administrator on the desk this week.

tasks.altitude: The meeting and the desk walk stay. The counts are ready. The administrator can stop a note that adds a priority the meeting did not set.

reach.task: Direct a front-of-house team from a daily count
reach.learn: Which counts are worth a meeting and which are not

evidence.claim: Directing three student-service offices is a meeting plus presence at peak. The counts are the preparation.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: weekly direction of admissions, registration and career services. Deciding an individual admission is a separate task.
Structured fields: period, programme id, admissions stage count, registration count, careers queue count. Each office produces its own count. A missing office is shown as missing, not as zero.
Use each system's own queue report before a custom dashboard. Test that configuration first.
unknowns: Whether the three offices use the same programme id.
Who attends the direction meeting besides the administrator.
research_questions: Are the three queues already in one report, or in three places?

incremental.description: Keep the pipeline definitions aligned with admissions and registration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the meeting and the desk walk dominate, and counts are disputed. High: the queues are trusted and the note is a short edit. The meeting and the desk stay. Not a measured saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Appoint faculty and evaluate their performance.

steps.what: Read the faculty case file and teaching record.

loop.input: The case file and the teaching record
loop.output: A brief of posts, dates and evidence lines, each with its source page
loop.check: Administrator checks every line against the file
loop.stop: One pass. A missing document is listed as missing, not filled in.
loop.why_not_simpler: Case files mix letters, evaluations and scans

steps.what: Interview the individual for the faculty position.
Appoint individuals to faculty positions or decline.
Issue the appointment letter for signature.
Collect teaching and service facts for the review.
Evaluate faculty performance and record the rating.

tasks.design: A bounded pass briefs the faculty case file with a source page on each line. The interview and the decision to appoint or decline stay with the administrator. The {ESIGN} letter is generated only from that decision. Later, a {TALENT} pack of teaching facts is ready, and the rating is recorded only after the review conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Case files were read from scratch, and the letter and the rating were typed from notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Teaching records can be listed by course, and a letter template can follow a recorded decision. The decision itself cannot.
tasks.still_hard: The interview, the appointment, and the performance conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator appoints and rates. A brief does not. Staff decisions are not left to a score.

ambition.what: Whether a faculty file is complete enough to go to interview, within a week of the file opening.

tasks.altitude: Interviews and review conversations stay. The file is briefed first. The administrator can refuse a letter or a rating that does not match the conversation.

reach.task: Appoint a senior clinician and review their work
reach.learn: Which evidence is missing from a file before the panel meets

evidence.claim: GDPR Article 22 names staff decisions as ones that must not rest on automation alone.
The EU AI Act treats hiring and evaluation of staff as a high-risk use. A person makes the decision.
Dutch works-council consent can be required for staff-data arrangements. Other countries differ. Ask before a new staff view.
An appointment interview and a performance conversation are not a file summary.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: one faculty appointment and one later performance review. Pay and promotion committees beyond this decision are out of scope.
Structured fields: person id, post id, decision (appoint, decline), letter template id, course id, rating code. The panel produces the decision. A missing document stays missing.
Use the talent system's review form and the signature tool's template before custom code.
A new arrangement for staff performance data needs works-council consent where national rules require it.
unknowns: Who else must vote before an appointment is final.
Whether the works council has consented to the review pack.
research_questions: Is the teaching record complete enough to show a panel without a manual addendum?

incremental.description: Keep appointment templates and rating codes aligned with the staff rules

approvals.approved_version: appointment decision recorded at the panel
appointment letter generated from that panel decision
faculty performance rating recorded after the review conversation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: files are incomplete and the conversations dominate. High: the brief and the review pack are checked quickly. Interviews, the appointment and the rating stay. Not a measured saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop curricula and recommend revisions and additions.

steps.what: Gather completion and enrolment for the current curricula.
Draft curriculum revisions from the completion results.

loop.input: Completion evidence and the current curriculum text
loop.output: A revision draft that quotes the module and the completion figure it rests on
loop.check: Administrator removes any change that has no figure or no faculty note
loop.stop: One draft. A module with no completion data is not rewritten.
loop.why_not_simpler: Curriculum text is prose. The figure only shows where to look

steps.what: Discuss the revision with faculty who teach it.
Recommend the curriculum addition or the revision.
File the recommended curriculum in the approval pack.

tasks.design: Completion and enrolment for the current curricula come from the {LMS} into a {BI} view. A bounded pass drafts revisions only where a figure and the current text can be quoted. Faculty discuss the draft. The administrator recommends the addition or revision, and {WORKFLOW} files that signed text. Faculty own the curriculum.
tasks.previous_blocker: Revisions were written from experience, and completion figures were added later if at all.
tasks.enabler_now: Completion by module can show where a text is worth opening. It cannot choose the new text.
tasks.still_hard: The faculty discussion and the recommendation of what to add or retire.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator signs the recommendation. A completion rate does not retire a module.

ambition.what: Which module to retire when its completion is poor, once a year for each programme.

tasks.altitude: The faculty discussion stays. Evidence is ready before it. The administrator can refuse a revision the discussion did not support.

reach.learn: Which outcome lines are comparable across stages and which are not

evidence.claim: Curriculum work stays with the people who teach it. Drafting help is the limit.
A system that decided access to education or a learning outcome would be a high-risk use. This task only recommends a text.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: from completion evidence to a filed recommendation. Approving the curriculum in the faculty board is that board's task.
Structured fields: programme id, module id, curriculum version, completion count, enrolment count. The learning system produces completions. A module with no id is listed and not rewritten.
Use the learning system's curriculum record before a custom store. Test that configuration first.
unknowns: Who may recommend a curriculum change.
Whether completion is comparable across modules.
research_questions: Are module ids stable across curriculum versions?

incremental.description: Update module ids when a curriculum version is replaced

approvals.approved_version: curriculum recommendation the administrator signed after the faculty discussion
curriculum recommendation the administrator signed after the faculty discussion

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: faculty rewrite the draft and completion is a weak signal. High: the draft is a starting redline and the discussion stays. Not a measured saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Consult regulators so the institution meets their standards.

steps.what: Mark regulatory standards that apply to the institution.

loop.output: A list of obligations, each with the clause it came from
loop.check: Administrator confirms the clause before the obligation is used
loop.stop: One pass. A clause the pass cannot quote is left for the administrator to type.
loop.why_not_simpler: Standards are long documents, not a checklist

steps.what: Collect the evidence each standard asks for.
Draft the conformance pack with gaps marked.

loop.input: The standards map and the evidence pack
loop.output: A pack that shows met, gap, or unknown for each obligation
loop.check: Administrator checks each gap against the evidence, not the summary
loop.stop: One draft. Missing evidence is 'unknown', not 'failed'.
loop.why_not_simpler: The pack has to follow the clauses, which do not share one layout

steps.what: Consult government licensing agencies on the open gaps.
Edit the conformance reply the agency asked for.

loop.input: Agency notes and the conformance draft
loop.output: A reply limited to what the agency asked
loop.check: Administrator edits every statement before it can be sent
loop.stop: One draft. A claim with no evidence id is removed.
loop.why_not_simpler: The ask is in the meeting or the letter, not in a fixed reply form

steps.what: Send the conformance reply to the agency.

tasks.design: A bounded pass quotes obligations from the licensing text, and evidence already held in {DOCS}, the {LMS} or {HCM} is attached by id. Gaps are marked unknown when evidence is missing. The consultation with the government licensing agency stays a meeting. The reply leaves {EMAIL} or the {GOV_PORTAL} only after the administrator edits it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Standards were read by hand and the evidence was hunted in folders before every visit.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded pass can quote a clause and a file can be attached by id. What the agency will accept is still a conversation.
tasks.still_hard: The consultation itself, and judging whether a gap is real.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator sends the reply. A gap list is not a filing.
tasks.altitude: The agency meeting stays. The pack is assembled beforehand. The administrator can refuse a reply that claims evidence the pack does not hold.

reach.task: Answer a regulator from a controlled file
reach.learn: Which evidence is a source document and which is only a summary

evidence.claim: A policy product can classify regulatory text and flag gaps. A person still decides what to tell the agency.
Corlytics Clausematch keeps a versioned policy library and can summarise regulatory documents. That does not file this institution's reply.
The agency meeting decides what evidence is accepted. The pack only prepares it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: one licensing or regulatory consultation, from the standard to the sent reply. Changing internal procedures is a separate task.

Structured fields: standard id, clause id, obligation text, evidence document id, status (met, gap, unknown). The administrator confirms the clause. If the text cannot be quoted, the obligation is typed by hand.
Use the document store's existing folders and the portal's upload before a custom compliance tool. Test native configuration first.
A regulatory-monitoring product aimed at financial firms is not assumed to cover education licensing.
unknowns: Which agency is in scope this year.
Which evidence documents are already controlled.
Who may send a reply besides the administrator.
research_questions: Is the current licensing text already in the document store as text, or only as a scan?

incremental.description: Update the standards map when a licensing text changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the standards are new and the meeting rewrites the pack. High: clauses are already mapped and the reply is an edit. The consultation stays. Not a measured saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Queue counts, case briefs, completion tables and standards maps are ready before the meeting. Direction, interviews, faculty discussion and agency consultations stay. Appointment letters, ratings, curriculum recommendations and regulator replies go out only on a version the administrator has signed.
reach: Regulatory affairs managers can reuse a clause-and-evidence map, not the education standards themselves
Medical and health services managers can see which pieces of a case file are missing before a panel
skills_to_grow: Signing an appointment only from the panel decision
Recommending a curriculum change the faculty discussion actually supported
Marking missing regulatory evidence as unknown
role.ambitious_version: No faculty letter goes out without the panel decision on it, and no regulator reply claims a document the pack does not hold.
